run_k_means_clustering: run k-means clustering on SELAVI PS matrices and compute NMI, aNMI, aRI, purity, and clustering accuracy metrics
compute_accuracy_topk: compute precision@k accuracy for torch model outputs against ground truth targets
normalize_vectors: normalize numpy arrays along a specified axis using L2 norm with fallback for zero vectors
find_hungarian_match: find optimal one-to-one cluster label matching between predictions and ground truth using linear sum assignment
compute_cluster_accuracy: reorder cluster predictions using hungarian match and compute clustering accuracy against ground truth
